name: claude-obsidian
description: Self-organizing AI second brain for Obsidian + Claude Code. Drop any source and Claude reads, links, and files it into one connected knowledge graph of plain Markdown you own.
one_liner: Drop any article, PDF, or note in, and an AI files it into a connected, searchable second brain made of plain Markdown files you fully own.
buyer: Researchers, consultants, and lawyers who accumulate mountains of sources and need them organized and cited, but refuse to trust a cloud note app with sensitive material.
business_use_cases: A consultant builds a private, source-cited knowledge base per client that answers questions with evidence.
A researcher ingests hundreds of papers and gets linked notes that flag contradictions between sources.
A small law office keeps a local, owned archive of case material an AI can search and ground answers in.

money_ideas.idea: A managed setup + hosting service for professionals who want a private AI second brain but can't configure one.
Sell profession-specific templates (legal, academic, medical) that structure the vault correctly out of the box.

steal_this: Offer a 'your research library, organized by AI, that never leaves your laptop' setup service to PhD students and consultants for a one-time fee.
